notes.title: Patch notes - New levels
notes.notes:
Last week we sent for free new content, which included Multiplayer mode and achievements.

This week we start making our promise come true at sending new levels, from now we sent 4 new levels and opened the "select chapter" option, which mean that now we are able to upload new levels whenever we want to. 

We are looking to send another 5 new levels this same week but as we are a little busy also working in other new content for this same week, we well need to do our best to make it possible.

Hope you like the new levels and if you still did not send a review of our game, we encourage you to do it so we can know what the people think about our game.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Achievements and Multiplayer mode
notes.notes:
Hello how are you?

As we already said, we are looking to upload new content each week and we will keep our word. This week we focused in [b]Achievements[/b] and a [b]Multiplayer Mode[/b].

First of all the game has achievements now and you can unlock them so you can enjoy more to win, or to die... there are 2 hidden achiements which are for future updates.

Then, we maked a first version for the Multiplayer mode, what is it? Well is a local Multiplayer where you will be able to play with a friend with your [b]Gamepad or Keyboard[/b]. We decided to make it live vs live, which mean that you will not play at the same time, in that way the game will not be more confusing and difficult than now, only more funny. We want it to be more difficult but not to annoy you guys (there are reviews from people that can't complete some levels and that's not our mission)

[b]So, the rules are basic:[/b]
   • If both players win the level, so the winner will be selected from the Player who have completed the level in less time.
   • If the Player 1 die and the Player 2 win, then Player 2 will be the winner (and vice versa)
   • If no one wins, then level and time will be reset for both.

Enjoy this update and don't forget to let your friends know how much you like our game.

[b]WAIT FOR 5-10 NEW LEVELS THIS WEEK FOR A NEW CHAPTER 2[/b]

Have a nice week and thanks for playing Blaite ːsteamhappyː
